name: Lesson 4: Pronouns
descriptionHtml:
1. Question type

This section requires you to select the correct type of pronoun from four options A, B, C, D to fill in the blank. 

 

2. Guide to answer 

- Identify which type of pronoun is needed in the blank. 

+ For personal pronouns, if the blank replaces a subject, it is a subject pronoun (I, She, He, etc). If the blank replaces an object, it is an object pronoun (me, him, her).

+ For possessives, if the blank modifies a noun, it is a possessive adjective (my, your, our, etc). If the blank replaces a noun, it is a possessive pronoun (mine, yours, ours, etc)

- Choose the correct form of pronoun.
